notes.title: Playtest Update 20250609_01
notes.notes:
新增了6个和爆炸/冷冻相关的道具
若干道具的效果调整
新增了新手教学
新增了通关过后的数据统计
新增了道具偏好——例如，现在仅当你拥有炸弹后，才会出现“炸弹效果增强”的道具选项

Added a tutorial for beginners
Added statistics tracking after completing levels
Added item preferences—for example, now the "Enhanced Bomb Effect" item option will only appear when you already have a bomb
